title: tsdb: cache collected head chunks on ChunkReader for O(1) lookup

target.summary: Cache validation only checks the head pointer and mmapped chunk count, failing to detect head-chunk truncation where older chunks are removed and s.firstChunkID advances. Lookups against the stale cached slice return data for the wrong chunk or fail with storage.ErrNotFound.
notes: faulty cache validation condition omitting firstChunkID check
cache fields in headChunkReader missing firstChunkID tracking
call site retrieving and passing cached head chunks
lookup indexing into cached head chunks relying on firstChunkID-derived offset
